messages.出血を付与する味方と組んで敵の出血を6以上にし、呼吸を貯めた状態で1コインのS3: Work with allies to put at least 6 Bleed on an enemy, then build Poise and land a critical with single-Coin S3 Sky-clearing Cut to inflict 10 Bleed. At 5 or more Poise, her passive Dark Cloud Blade also turns her counter into Sky-clearing Cut.
messages.S3「快刀乱麻」: 1コイン(7+16/18)。対象の出血が6以上ならクリティカ: **S3 — Sky-clearing Cut**: 1 Coin (7+16/18). Doubled Critical chance if the target has at least 6 Bleed, and +100% Critical damage if she has at least 10 Poise. Inflicts 10 Bleed on Critical Hit.
messages.呼吸の確保: S2「飛び散る剣撃」は使用時に呼吸回数+1/2、Ⅰ・Ⅱコインで呼吸: **Securing Poise**: S2 Scattering Slash adds +1/2 Poise Count on use, grants 1/2 and 2/3 Poise with Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ, and gains +2 Coin Power at 5 or more Poise. S1 Sharpened Blade grants 2/4 Poise on Heads Hit and gains +2 Coin Power at 4 or more Poise. The Defense skill Counter grants +2 Poise Count and 1 Protection on use.
messages.出血の付与: 自分で出血を付与できるのはS2(Ⅰコイン1/2・Ⅱコイン2/3)と: **Inflicting Bleed**: Her only sources of Bleed are S2 (Coin Ⅰ 1/2, Coin Ⅱ 2/3) and Sky-clearing Cut's Critical Hit. S1 does not inflict Bleed.
messages.バトルパッシブ「黒雲刀」(色欲×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 反撃時、自分の呼吸: **Combat passive — Dark Cloud Blade (4 Lust Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: When countering, if she has at least 5 Poise, the counter activates as Skill 3 (Sky-clearing Cut). In that case, she does not get the regular Counter's on-use effects (1 Protection, +2 Poise Count).
messages.サポートパッシブ「黒雲剣術」(憂鬱×5・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 速度が最も低い: **Support passive — Dark Cloud Swordsmanship (5 Gloom Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: +10% Slash skill damage for the 1 slowest ally.
messages.S2の付与量は最大でも出血5なので、出血6以上の条件は味方の出血付与で満たすのが: S2 inflicts at most 5 Bleed, so the 6-Bleed condition is basically met through allies' Bleed infliction (pair her with Bleed Identities or Poise supporters). Earn Poise and Poise Count with S2 to reach 5 or more Poise, then land S3 on a bleeding enemy. Her only ways to increase Poise Count are S2 and Counter, and once Dark Cloud Blade triggers, Counter no longer grants it, so expect Poise to run out within a few turns and rebuild by slotting in S2. Also, none of her skills grant Aggro, so the chances to deliberately bring out the Dark Cloud Blade counter are limited.
